text:
Anya: Morning team! spontaneous idea: desk-hydration bingo. winner gets a sticker and ultimate bragging rights. :trophy:
Sam: I'm game. what are the squares? :droplet::cup_with_straw:
Anya: top row = drank water in last hour, brought a reusable bottle, left a glass in the sink overnight. middle = iced drink, herb tea, accidentally spilled water. bottom = bought a fancy bottle, convinced a coworker to hydrate, refilled at the fountain.
Jess: i already have herb tea + reusable. peak tuesday.
Leo: i'll participate only if 'sipped coffee and called it hydration' is allowed. :grimacing:
Marta: add a wild card: "refilled someone else's bottle"? heroic move yesterday. :cape:
Anya: wild card accepted. quick poll: react :white_check_mark: if you're in, :x: if not.
Sam: :white_check_mark:
Leo: :white_check_mark: (mostly coffee points)
HydrationBot: BINGO ALERT — Leo completed the top row at 3123456795. Prize: one mythical sticker. :confetti_ball:
Leo: wait how did i become hydration royalty?
Jess: congrats! claim your sticker from snack shelf 2.
Marta: one-liner time: "Hydration is just showering your insides." you're welcome.
Sam: my one-liner: "Drink water like it's your job — your cells are unionizing."
Anya: shoutout to Marta for saving my lid from the fridge yesterday. lifesaver. :pray:
Jess: small logistics: can someone label the left side of the fridge 'science experiments'? found an unidentified jar. :eyes:
Marta: labeled it "prehistoric smoothie."
Anya: leaderboard goes on the whiteboard by the coffee station. 1 sticker for the victor. keep it silly and kind. :sparkles:
